maria_ng: Quick repro: Windows 10, Python 3.11.3, fresh venv. Async SDK call fails with SSL cert verify inside httpcore; sync call works.

alex_k: Can you paste the error and the async snippet?

maria_ng: Error: ssl.SSLError CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED. Snippet: `asyncio.run(main())` where AsyncRedwoodClient(..., verify=r'C:\temp\combined.pem').

sam_w: Two guesses: 1) event loop policy on Windows (Proactor) + TLS backend differences, 2) httpcore async path not loading the bundle. What are httpx/httpcore versions?

maria_ng: httpx 0.24.0 / httpcore 0.16.0. certifi present and combined bundle works with curl/requests.

gina_ops: Typical workaround: set SSL_CERT_FILE env var to combined bundle and confirm curl/python requests succeed. Also note pyinstaller can drop certifi data.

alex_k: Filing issue to track: Windows async TLS verify with custom bundle + typing stubs for Async client. Will add Windows troubleshooting to quickstart.

devex-bot: Created GH #3249: "Windows async TLS verify + Async typing note" https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/3249 :robot_face:

maria_ng: Thx — switching to alpha SDK + older httpcore temporarily fixed it, will post repro in the issue. Also mypy flagged missing async overloads; a short typing note in quickstart would be great.
